title: Personal vault
subtitle: Logins and notes that are only yours, encrypted in your browser. This vault only opens from the web dashboard.

errors.load: Could not load the vault. Reload the page.
errors.conflict: The vault changed in another tab. We reloaded the latest version. Try again.
errors.reauth: For security, the vault only opens with a sign-in made after this update. Sign out and sign in again.

passwords.masterHelp: At least 12 characters. Use a different password from your login.
passwords.extraHelp: At least 8 characters. Opens only the items with extra protection.

errors.masterShort: The master password must have at least 12 characters.
errors.masterMismatch: The master passwords do not match.
errors.extraShort: The extra password must have at least 8 characters.
errors.extraMismatch: The extra passwords do not match.
errors.extraSameAsMaster: The extra password must be different from the master password.

setup.title: Create your personal vault
setup.description: Keep social media logins, accounts and secure notes outside your projects. Everything is encrypted here in the browser before it reaches the server.

recoverySheet.title: Recovery key
recoverySheet.description: Print or write down this key and keep it somewhere safe. It is shown only now.
recoverySheet.warning: Without the master password or this recovery key, nobody can open this vault, not even the CriptEnv team.

unlock.title: Vault locked
unlock.description: Enter the master password to open it. The vault locks itself after 10 minutes of inactivity.

recovery.title: Recover the vault
recovery.description: Use the printed recovery key to set new passwords. A new key is generated and the old one stops working.
recovery.invalidKey: Invalid recovery key. Check the characters.
recovery.wrongKey: This key does not open this vault.
recovery.conflict: The vault changed in another tab. The key shown was not saved and is not valid. Run the recovery again.

items.emptyDescription: Add a login or a secure note.

itemDialog.title: Title
itemDialog.protectedHelp: Password, notes and content open only with the extra password.
itemDialog.unlockDescription: This item has extra protection. Enter the extra password to edit it.
itemDialog.conflict: This item changed in another tab. We reloaded the latest version.

reveal.unlockDescription: This item has extra protection. Enter the extra password to see it.

settings.title: Vault settings
settings.description: Changing a password does not change the recovery key.
